name: Digger By Digtective
author: digtective

sections.description:
Connect your WordPress site to Digger to allow for ad attribution and sales cycle tracking for correct ad analytics.

Session Management

Our plugin is a GDPR tracking system. Due to the needs of GDPR we have to do all our tracking via the server without collecting personal data.
For this very reason our app uses session_start() on every page. The data stored in the session is then used in our tool to get correct attribution.

Third-Party Integrations

We support seamless integration with multiple third-party platforms to enhance your tracking accuracy and streamline your marketing efforts.

  • WooCommerce

  • Elementor Forms

  • Gravity Forms

  • HubSpot Forms

We utilize the APIs of these platforms to connect with their custom forms and extract the necessary data for tracking.

WooCommerce – Ensures precise tracking of eCommerce transactions and conversions.

WooCommerce API Documentation

Elementor Forms – Captures form submissions and integrates them into the tracking system.

Elementor Forms API Documentation

Gravity Forms – Tracks form interactions for better attribution.

Gravity Forms API Documentation

HubSpot Forms – Connects with HubSpot’s API to retrieve tracking data.

HubSpot API Documentation

The current URLs used:

  • *.hsforms.net

  • hsforms.net

We are continuously expanding our list of supported platforms!

If you have a specific integration request, let us know—we prioritize what matters most to our users.
